### 1.1 Core commitment

The seam is a **declaration form, not an expression form.** There is no expression in the safe grammar that opens proof-land. Proof terms `π` occur in exactly one syntactic position: the `by`-field of a method inside a `seal` declaration. The safe fragment is NLL-as-shipped, unchanged. The seam exports values to it through a single contract — the **Re-Import Contract (RIC)** — and the bug in the prior round is fixed by *changing what disjointness means*: it is no longer capability identity (`c₁≠c₂`, vacuous on one handle), it is **separating-conjunction well-formedness over non-duplicable points-to resources**, which is *provably false* for aliasing rather than vacuously true.

### 1.1 What a seam may hand back (the safe interface surface)

A seam-crossed primitive may return only values typed in NLL's own grammar:

```
τ ::= S                      -- owned scalar/struct (lives in caller frame)
    | &'a τ  | &'a mut τ     -- NLL shared / unique borrow
    | Owned<τ, A>            -- affine owned heap cell from allocator A (this is Box)
    | Send-of(τ) | Sync-of(τ)  -- auto-trait status, computed structurally
```

Nothing else crosses. Safe code that receives a `τ` does **zero** resource reasoning; it runs the stock borrow checker. All machinery below is **ghost** (erased; §1.5).

So re-import must either drop the un-encodable conjunct, yielding UB in pure safe code (split2(0,0) gives two &mut to one cell; a relaxed-linearizable object lets weak-memory-blind code reason sequentially and accept a data race), or keep the obligation alive in ordinary code, reinstating the per-call ATS2 proof tax concentration was meant to abolish. Concentration cannot rescue it because the foundation proofs are themselves Iris-grade and open (per-structure custom cameras / synchronized ghost state), hence neither decidable nor closeable into a handful of AI-legible reusable primitives.

incompatibilities.property_at_risk: Decidable AND proof-free in the SAFE FRAGMENT, Sound re-import, Seam CONCENTRATION
incompatibilities.description: A decidable proof-free seam logic is too weak to soundly re-import foundational primitives — Zero-cost erasure deletes any runtime trap/check identically to an honest proof, so each crossing's soundness must be discharged statically; to keep ordinary code decidable and proof-free, that static logic collapses to UTVPI/QF-LIA-bounded refinements. But the real invariants of the named primitives are not in any such fragment — allocator size is nonlinear (rows*cols*sizeof≤CAP), split_at_mut is disjointness/ownership (RustBelt's Iris, not arithmetic), and ℤ-indices versus modular usize make the weak logic actively unsound (reflect injects m=2⁶⁴; one-sided NoWrap underflows hi−lo to −2 → erased OOB). Strengthening the logic to discharge them soundly makes it undecidable and proof-bearing and pushes SMT/proofs into ordinary callers, collapsing concentration; so one of decidable-proof-free, sound-re-import, or concentration must give.
